name: net_restarted_game_rejoins
description: Two seats played by the plan bots; client 2's game notes its seat in user://net.cfg (Identity.hold_seat, as a --join game does). Past the first kept checkpoint its game is killed: the link drops with no goodbye and its MatchClient is gone; the seat goes AWAY after its silence and the caretaker plays it. The game started again has only user:// to go by: Identity.held_seat names match 1's wire seat 1, so its first HELLO is a resume naming it, with the same token. MATCH_CONFIG(rejoin) builds the match from the config (no LOADED, no orders), RESYNC(rejoin) loads the latest agreed checkpoint and the turns since; it catches up, says shown, and BACK hands the seat back at the next build window. It numbers its orders above the sequence floor the note kept (the sequencer wants a seat's numbers strictly increasing, so a game that began again at 1 was refused), every hash it sends from the checkpoint on agrees, and the game started again notes the seat afresh.

steps.msg: client 2's seat is noted from its MATCH_CONFIG (client 1 notes none)
a checkpoint past tick 0 is kept
the killed game's silence put its seat AWAY: the caretaker plays it
the note's sequence floor is above every command number the killed game sent

steps.assert: scene.client(2).boot_resume and scene.client(2).held_match == 1 and scene.client(2).held_seat == 1 and scene.client(2).token == token
steps.msg: started again, its first HELLO asks back the seat user://net.cfg noted, with the same token
the overlay says reconnecting while it asks

steps.assert: rejoined and scene.seq.rejoins == 1 and scene.client(2).resyncs[0][0] == 'rejoin' and scene.client(2).resyncs[0][1] > 0 and not scene.client(2).boot_resume
steps.msg: MATCH_CONFIG(rejoin) built the match and RESYNC(rejoin) loaded a checkpoint past tick 0

steps.assert: scene.client(2).seat == 2 and scene.client(2).sim.seats.size() == 2 and scene.client(2).match_seed == scene.client(1).match_seed
steps.msg: the match it built from the config is the one it left: its seat, both seats, the seed
the overlay said reconnecting, then catching up, then welcome back while the caretaker holds the seat
its seat was handed back at a build window, and its orders go out
every hash from the checkpoint on agrees, and the match plays on
the game started again numbers its orders above the floor: the sequencer stamped them into turns and refused none
the game started again notes the seat as its own
